Kiwix changes: use checked string scans, byte writes and text slicing in the
reader, writer and Value formatter. Deny unsafe Rust with four scoped exceptions
for the existing `raw_value` feature's representation and unchecked constructor.
Keep the published API and feature selection. Add coverage of UTF-8 and escapes
across the reader's scan chunk boundaries.
